an7.54:1.1: [sāvatthinidānaṃ] atha kho aññataro bhikkhu yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami. upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi. ekamantaṃ nisinno kho so bhikkhu bhagavantaṃ etadavoca:
an7.54:1.2: ko nu kho bhante, hetu ko paccayo yena sutavato ariyasāvakassa vicikicchā nūppajjati avyākatavatthusu.
an7.54:2.1: diṭṭhinirodhā kho bhikkhu, sutavato ariyasāvakassa vicikicchā nūppajjati avyākatavatthusu.
an7.54:2.2: “hoti tathāgato parammaraṇā”ti, kho bhikkhu, diṭṭhigata metaṃ.
an7.54:2.3: “na hoti tathāgato parammaraṇā”ti kho bhikkhu diṭṭhigatametaṃ.
an7.54:2.4: “hoti ca na hoti ca tathāgato parammaraṇā”ti kho bhikkhu, diṭṭhigatametaṃ
an7.54:2.5: “neva hoti na na hoti tathāgato parammaraṇā”ti kho bhikkhu diṭṭhigatametaṃ.
an7.54:2.6: assutavā bhikkhu, puthujjano diṭṭhiṃ nappajānāti, diṭṭhisamudayaṃ nappajānāti, diṭṭhinirodhaṃ nappajānāti, diṭṭhinirodhagāminiṃ paṭipadaṃ nappajānāti.
an7.54:2.7: tassa sā diṭṭhi pavaḍḍhati. so na parimuccati jātiyā jarāmaraṇena sokehi paridevehi dukkhehi domanassehi upāyāsehi, na parimuccati dukkhasmāti vadāmi.
an7.54:3.1: sutavā ca kho bhikkhu, ariyasāvako diṭṭhiṃ pajānāti, diṭṭhisamudayaṃ pajānāti, diṭṭhinirodhaṃ pajānāti, diṭṭhinirodhagāminiṃ paṭipadaṃ pajānāti.
an7.54:3.2: tassa sā diṭṭhi nirujjhati. so parimuccati jātiyā jarāmaraṇena sokehi paridevehi dukkhehi domanassehi upāyāyehi, parimuccati dukkhasmāti vadāmi.
an7.54:3.3: evaṃ jānaṃ kho bhikkhu, sutavā ariyasāvako evaṃ passaṃ “hoti tathāgato parammaraṇāti”pi na vyākaroti.
an7.54:3.5: “hoti ca na hoti ca tathāgato parammaraṇāti”pi na vyākaroti.
an7.54:3.6: “neva hoti na na hoti tathāgato parammaraṇāti’pi na vyākaroti.
an7.54:3.7: evaṃ jānaṃ kho bhikkhu, sutavā ariyasāvako evaṃ passaṃ evaṃ avyākaraṇadhammo hoti avyākatavatthusu.
an7.54:3.8: evaṃ jānaṃ kho bhikkhu, sutavā ariyasāvako evaṃ passaṃ nacchambhati, na kampati, na calati, na vedhati, na santāsaṃ āpajjati avyākatavatthusu.
an7.54:4.7: “na hoti tathāgato parammaraṇā”ti kho bhikkhu …pe… vippaṭisāro eso.
an7.54:4.8: “hoti ca na hoti ca tathāgato parammaraṇā”ti kho bhikkhu …pe… vippaṭisāro eso.
an7.54:4.9: “neva hoti na na hoti tathāgato parammaraṇā”ti kho bhikkhu …pe… vippaṭisāro eso.
an7.54:4.10: assutavā bhikkhu, puthujjano vippaṭisāraṃ nappajānāti. vippaṭisārasamudayaṃ nappajānāti, vippaṭisāranirodhaṃ nappajānāti, vippaṭisāranirodha gāminiṃ paṭipadaṃ nappajānāti.
an7.54:4.11: tassa so vippaṭisāro pavaḍḍhati. so na parimuccati jātiyā jarāmaraṇena sokehi paridevehi dukkhehi domanassehi upāyāsehi. na parimuccati dukkhasmāti vadāmi.
an7.54:5.1: sutavā ca kho bhikkhu, ariyasāvako vippaṭisāraṃ pajānāti, vippaṭisārasamudayaṃ pajānāti, vippaṭisāranirodhaṃ pajānāti, vippaṭisāranirodhagāminiṃ paṭipadaṃ pajānāti.
an7.54:5.2: tassa so vippaṭisāro nirujjhati. so parimuccati jātiyā jarāmaraṇena sokehi paridevehi dukkhehi domanassehi upāyāsehi. parimuccati dukkhasmāti vadāmi.
an7.54:5.3: evaṃ jānaṃ kho bhikkhu, sutavā ariyasāvako evaṃ passaṃ “hoti tathāgato parammaraṇā”tipi na vyākaroti, “na hoti tathāgato parammaraṇā”tipi na vyākaroti, “hoti ca na hoti ca tathāgato parammaraṇā”tipi na vyākaroti,
an7.54:5.4: “neva hoti na na hoti tathāgato parammaraṇā”tipi na vyākaroti.
an7.54:5.5: evaṃ jānaṃ kho bhikkhu, sutavā ariyasāvako evaṃ passaṃ evaṃ avyākaraṇadhammo hoti avyākatavatthusu.
an7.54:5.6: evaṃ jānaṃ kho bhikkhu, sutavā ariyasāvako evaṃ passaṃ nacchambhati, na kampatina na calati, na vedhati, na santāsaṃ āpajjati avyākatavatthusu.
an7.54:5.7: ayaṃ kho bhikkhu, hetu, ayaṃ paccayo yena sutavato ariyasāvakassa vicikicchā nuppajjati avyākatavatthusūti.
